messages:
mara: ok team — I'm consolidating the launch acceptance gates for the console observability surface. want to winnow customer-driven asks before EOD so eng can scope. TL;DR: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics.

devin: thanks — can you call out which customers are blocking on which feature?

mara: short list: FinPay needs cost breakdown per-route, NeoMaps wants tracing hooks (span sampling + quick traces), Atlas wants error analytics slices (5xx attribution + example traces). several smaller customers want dashboards templates.

sylvia: for prioritization, I'd rank: 1) cost per-route (FinPay SLA) 2) tracing hooks for quick root-cause 3) error analytics baseline 4) dashboard templates. cost impacts renewals.

aj: +1 on ordering but want to consider implementation complexity. tracing hooks needs infra changes (sampling config + lightweight span export). error analytics could be started with existing logs + basic aggregation.

leo: from eng side: rough effort estimates: cost per-route UI + backend: 3w (api + aggregation + UI). tracing hooks: 4-6w (sampling, KV cache handling, instrumentation). error analytics MVP: 2w for aggregation + 1w for UI. dashboards templates: 1w templates + docs.

mara: good. proposal: aim for phased launch: phase A (cost per-route MVP + error analytics baseline + 2 dashboard templates), phase B (tracing hooks + expanded templates). phase A target: GA-ish for self-serve customers; phase B is gated by infra completion.

devin: can we define acceptance criteria for phase A so we can sign-off with customers?

mara: yes — draft below. please iterate.

mara: ```Acceptance Criteria (Phase A):
- Cost per-route: daily & hourly breakdowns, +/- 5% accuracy vs billing, route filter, export CSV.
- Error Analytics baseline: top-10 error slices, ability to link to 3 example traces per slice, alert rule for spike detection (>x baseline).
- Dashboards: two prebuilt templates (cost overview, error hotspots) with responsive layout and export-to-pdf.
- Performance: dashboard queries under 1.5s 95th for 30d retention sample.
- Security: RBAC respects existing project-level roles.
```

sylvia: spike detection threshold needs definition — suggest default = 3 sigma over 14d moving window + option to customize.

aj: note on performance: 1.5s 95th is doable for small customers but for orgs with huge traffic we need reservation guidance. maybe document expected scale and provide Dedicated capacity note.

mara: agreed — add explicit scale guidance on the docs and in the console.

leo: engineering asks: one extra SRE for 2w to validate query perf and add trace link plumbing, and a short-lived metrics job to validate cost reconciliation with billing (accuracy target). Also need product to confirm final CSV schema.

mara: action: @devin confirm customers for early validation (FinPay, NeoMaps, Atlas) by EOD tomorrow. @aj can you confirm SRE allocation? @leo please draft deployment plan and perf test checklist. I'll finalize acceptance criteria and share with sales for commit.

devin: will confirm FinPay + Atlas today, NeoMaps is tentative — pinging account exec.

aj: will coordinate with oncall, can allocate 1 SRE for weeks 2-3 of the sprint.

leo: I'll post a deployment plan doc + perf checklist in this thread by Tuesday. includes mock load scripts and reconciliation steps.

mara: thanks. small decision: do we expose per-route cost in UI by default, or behind a feature flag for early customers? I'm leaning feature-flag first (safer telemetry) — opinions?

devin: feature-flag for GA cadence seems right. gives us quick rollback path and lets us validate accuracy.

sylvia: flag + opt-in for accounts with >50k requests/day to avoid noise while we tune.

mara: ok feature-flag + account opt-in. I'll update the acceptance criteria to include feature flag and rollout plan.

ops-bot: reminder: runbook template for incidents updated 3 days ago — link: https://internal/runbooks/obs-launch

mara: final: I'll send a brief readout to GTM with the phase definitions and ask for validation customers. if anyone wants to veto ordering, speak now, otherwise I'll lock and create a product spec PR. :rocket:
